Onshape

Onshape provides browser-based parametric CAD, assemblies and controlled product collaboration.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Create a configurable part studio

Use current feature dimensions, datums and design intent. In the intended Onshape preview, create a configurable part studio; the visible result is the revised solid and its driving constraints. Review interfaces, retained references and manufacturable intent before accepting or exporting it.

Resolve an assembly revision

Start from the selected part or assembly revision. In the intended Onshape preview, resolve an assembly revision; the visible result is an updated assembly state with affected relationships highlighted. Review fit, motion, access and clearance before accepting or exporting it.

Review a branched design change

Begin with the reviewed model and release properties. In the intended Onshape preview, review a branched design change; the visible result is a drawing, bill of materials or model definition tied to that revision. Review dimensions, revision identity and downstream completeness before accepting or exporting it.
